findings.quoted_text: 9.1 The maximum liability of one Party to the other Party and its affiliates in relation to this Agreement will be [***] ("Liability Cap"), provided however that: 9.1.1 The Liability Cap will not apply to any (1) material confidentiality breach under Section 5, and/or (2) indemnification obligations under Section 7.1.
findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations are excluded from the liability cap, exposing you to unlimited financial liability for third-party claims.
findings.suggested_change: The Liability Cap shall apply to all claims and liabilities of either Party under this Agreement, including all indemnification obligations.
